review_notes: All ten phash-only pairs were recognizable as the same source photo after crop, resize, rotation, or color transformation; none appeared to be merely similar-but-distinct dogs or lesions.
All Roboflow-family pairs were augmented views of the same source photo.
All md5-exact pairs were visually identical as expected.
Thirty reviewed groups touched Bacterial_dermatosis; none showed a false-positive merge, so dedup did not remove a legitimate distinct bacterial photo in this sample.
The bacterial problem found in these groups is conflicting labels for the same photo, not erroneous duplicate detection: many are labeled Bacterial_dermatosis in dataset1 and Dermatitis elsewhere.
This is a 50-group sample, not proof that all 2,175 multi-member groups are error-free. Perceptual-hash threshold changes should repeat this audit.
